contentPattern.structure: image + bold title heading + description paragraph (non-linked)

suitableFor: 3-column feature/category card rows (image + bold title + description)
non-clickable highlight cards with prominent titles
topic or category showcases on light backgrounds
notSuitableFor: clickable article/blog cards with category tag and date (use cards-article)
image-only galleries with no text (use cards-gallery)
